title: Pure Maliss
summary: The pure Maliss Cyberse Link build with Firewall Dragon and generic staples. Every Main Deck Maliss pays 300 LP to Special Summon itself whenever it is banished, and every Maliss Trap can be activated the turn it is Set by banishing a face-up Maliss monster you control.

summary.title: Starters
points: Maliss P Dormouse (Limited) banishes a Maliss monster from the Deck so that monster can pay 300 LP to Special Summon itself immediately.
Maliss P White Rabbit (Limited) Sets a Maliss Trap directly from the Deck with a different name from the cards in your GY.
Maliss in Underground (Semi-Limited) banishes a Maliss card from your hand, Deck, or GY on activation to jump-start your banished summons.

summary.title: Opening: Dormouse or Underground into Red Ransom & Hearts Crypter
steps: Normal Summon Maliss P Dormouse or activate Maliss in Underground to banish Maliss P White Rabbit or Maliss P Chessy Cat, paying 300 LP to Special Summon the banished monster.
Use White Rabbit to Set Maliss C MTP-07 or Maliss C TB-11 from the Deck, and use Chessy Cat to banish another Maliss from your hand to draw 2 cards.

Climb into Link-3 Maliss Q Red Ransom to search Maliss in the Mirror or Maliss in Underground, then banish a Maliss monster to activate a Set Maliss Trap on the same turn and extend into Link-3 Maliss Q Hearts Crypter and Firewall Dragon.

summary.title: Banish-and-Return Engine
summary.text: Maliss P March Hare Special Summons itself from the hand during either Main Phase by banishing another Maliss card from your hand or GY, and adds a banished Maliss monster back to your hand when banished itself. Maliss Links also pay 900 LP to Special Summon themselves back whenever they are banished.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Maliss Q Hearts Crypter shuffles a banished Maliss card into the Deck as a Quick Effect on either turn to banish a card on the field; its activation cannot be negated while it points to a monster.
Maliss Q Red Ransom searches a Maliss Spell on Special Summon and swaps the original ATK and DEF of all opposing Effect Monsters while linked.
Firewall Dragon bounces monsters on the field or in the GY as a Quick Effect up to the number of monsters co-linked to it.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Maliss in the Mirror negates a face-up monster's effects by banishing a Maliss from your hand or field, and banishes a Maliss from your GY when banished itself to search a same-type Maliss card.
Maliss C MTP-07 searches a Maliss monster, and additionally banishes a card on the field if you banished a Maliss Link Monster to activate it.
Maliss C GWC-06 revives a Maliss from the GY or banishment and gains LP if you control a Maliss Link, while Maliss C TB-11 summons a Maliss from the Deck or a Maliss Link from the Extra Deck.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Maliss Q White Binder is Forbidden in the TCG.
